#!/bin/sh
exec 2>&1

wait_dep() {
    sv start "$1" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
    i=0
    until sv check "$1" >/dev/null 2>&1; do
        i=$((i+1))
        [ "$i" -ge 90 ] && { echo "dependency $1 not ready after 90s" >&2; exit 1; }
        sleep 1
    done
}
# Was `wait_dep ovsbr0-addr` until 2026-08-13. ovsbr0-addr's helper does not
# exist and its run script has no `set -e`, so its only real effect was to
# touch /run/opdbus/runit-ready/ovsbr0-addr — which this service and incusd
# both gated on. Retiring it (3tched-network-install.sh) therefore took both
# down. opdbus-rundirs is what actually creates the rundirs op-web needs.
wait_dep opdbus-rundirs
# The bridge owns CognitiveMcpServer and its single-writer RocksDB. Web must
# not start until the bridge has completed replay and opened its socket.
wait_dep op-grpc-bridge

set -a
[ -r /etc/op-dbus/environment ] && . /etc/op-dbus/environment
set +a

export PORT="${PORT:-8080}"
export OP_WEB_STATIC_DIR="${OP_WEB_STATIC_DIR:-/usr/local/share/op-dbus/dashboard}"
export OP_DBUS_GRPC_ADDR="${OP_DBUS_GRPC_ADDR:-https://localhost:8090}"
export OP_DBUS_GRPC_CA_FILE="${OP_DBUS_GRPC_CA_FILE:-/etc/op-dbus/tls/tonic-svc0.crt}"
# Who op-web is on the control plane. Without this, host_session_id() returns
# None and every gRPC call is refused before it leaves the process with
# "Host session id is unavailable; refusing unauthenticated gRPC call" —
# which is what took the whole dashboard down (all 12 unary RPCs erroring).
# This is the host's own identity record ("container zero") in identity_sled.
export IDENTITY_SLED_HOST_SESSION_ID="${IDENTITY_SLED_HOST_SESSION_ID:-5205f22a-8e7e-36dd-b9e4-165d844fc099}"
export COGNITIVE_MCP_CONTEXT_HTTP_DISABLED=1
export RUST_LOG="${RUST_LOG:-op_web=info,info}"

# NOTE the readiness token is written BEFORE the exec, so it asserts "the run
# script got this far", not "op-web-server is serving". `check` is what closes
# that gap — it tests the listener, not the token. Do not let anything gate on
# the token alone.
/usr/local/libexec/3tched/runit-ready-signal op-web
exec /usr/local/bin/op-web-server
